info.title: TransportInstruction
info.description: Used to submit complete transport data that forms the basis for the transport and invoicing

id.description: The shipment/tracking id: The unique global number that ensures that packages are not separated from each other during transport from one point to another. Leave empty to get it assigned automatically.

productCode.description: See the product documentation for available options.

pickupDate.description: Used with **DHL Eurapid** and **DHL EuroConnect**. The earliest pickup date. Depending on booking deadline and availability the pickup date may be altered by DHL Freight.

requestedDeliveryDate.description: Required with **DHL Eurapid** and Commited Delivery Date (CDD).

totalWeight.description: The shipemnts total weight weight in kg

totalVolume.description: The shipemnts total volume in m³

totalLoadingMeters.description: A loading meter (LDM) is 1 meter of the loading space of a truck’s width and full height. Usually calculated for goods that cannot be stacked on or with other goods.

totalPalletPlaces.description: Pallet place (PPL) is based on the dimensions of a EUR pallet: 120 × 80 cm. Usually calculated for goods that cannot be stacked on or with other goods. 1 PLL =  0.4 LDM.

code.description: See the product documentation for available options based on selected product.

id.description: For a consignor, consignee or freight payer the customer/agreement number. Mandatory on the part according to the payer code. For a access point, i.e. parcels shop, parcel station etc, this is the identifier of this location.

vatEoriSocialSecurityNumber.description: EORI (Economic operators registration and identification number) used for customs-related trade within the EU.

subType.description:
Use with access point to state if it’s a parcels shop, parcel station etc.
 
 For locationType locker, subType should be set to ParcelStation for all others to PracelShop

PartyVAT.description: According to Greece legislation for all transport to, from, and within Greece VAT or TAX ID is required.

countryCode.description: VAT country prefix, in general the country ISO code but deviation exist like CHE foe Switzerland and EL for Greece.

number.description: The 'number' part of the VAT, can include characters depending on the countries specific format.

id.description: The SSCC (Serial Shipping Container Code) a unique GS1/GS1-128 numbers used to identify a logistic unit, such as a case, pallet or parcel. Leave empty to get it assigned automatically.

packageType.description: See the product documentation for available options based on selected product.

postalCode.description: For Ireland county should be used as postal code, EirCode is not supported.

min.description: Required if type is **Custom**, else it should be omitted.

max.description: Required if type is **Custom**, else it should be omitted.

ThermoType.description:
**Cold** - the temperature during the transport chain is in the range of +2 to +8 °C. 
 

                           **Ambient** - the the temperature during the transport chain is in the range of +15 to +25 °C. 
 

                           Other temperature range after special written agreement (but not more than +25 °C). 
 

                           Temperature-controlled transport is carried out after special written agreement.

ThermoColdOptions.description: Thermo Cold means that the temperature during the transport chain is in the range of +2 to +8 °C. Other temperature range after special written agreement (but not more than +15 °C). Temperature-controlled transport is carried out after special written agreement and must always be specified when booking.

ThermoWarmOptions.description: Thermo Warm means that the goods are transported frost-free (at least +1 °C.Temperature-controlled transport is carried out after special written agreement and must always be specified when booking.

VoecSupplyVATOptions.description: VOEC (VAT On E-Commerce) used with ParcelConnect to Norway.

dgmId.description: Unique ADR identification. Only relevant if you use the vendor DG Office for ADR

adrClass.description: ADR Class is mandatory, but can be left empty for limited quantities (LQ) and excepted quantities (EQ)

packageGroup.description: Official ADR package group codes I, II, III or blanks

officialNameTechDescription.description: This is the additional technical name, only when required for UN-number with N.O.S. Not Otherwise Specified, so additional chemical substance name is then required.

netExplosiveMass.description: The total mass (kg) of active explosive and pyrotechnic substances within explosive articles (Class 1).
